fusions.name: Bursting Charge
fusions.desc: Fires a packed charge that bursts open into a mesh on the first enemy it meets, dealing 34 damage and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaving each [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Tethered Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round at a target already caught in one of your afflictions, using that affliction up, and deals 8 damage, up to 1.3 times that at its full reach of 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Launcher on a Tripod
fusions.desc: Sets up a conjured launcher for 15 seconds that fires mesh shot at enemies within 6 tiles, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds with a 30% chance to leave each target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sighted on the Snared
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your critical chance rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
